audience.text: Font engineering teams, web developers, and CI/CD pipelines that need deployable web-font packages, visual review assets, variable-font instances, and QA evidence from scripts, CLI, or MCP workflows.

capabilities.text: Open TrueType, OpenType, CFF, Type 1, WOFF, WOFF2, and EOT fonts using `FontLoader.open()` and inspect axes, named instances, and metrics.
capabilities.title: Open and inspect multiple font formats

capabilities.text: Instantiate variable fonts by axis coordinates or named instances using `SmartInstancer.instantiate()` with configurable naming strategies and STAT policy.
capabilities.title: Instantiate and customize variable fonts

capabilities.text: Subset fonts for web delivery with coverage analysis using `FontSubsetter.subset_for_web_with_coverage()` and preset-based codepoint resolution.
capabilities.title: Subset fonts for web delivery

capabilities.text: Generate PNG, SVG, HTML, and JSON review assets including family review boards, axis grids, delta comparisons, and QA reports.
capabilities.title: Generate visual and machine-readable review assets

capabilities.text: Inspect glyph and text deltas, active tuples, and interpolation issues between instances using `DeltaInspector` and `CompatibilityChecker`.
capabilities.title: Inspect variable-font interpolation and compatibility

capabilities.text: Support CLI workflows via `aspose_font.cli.main` and expose capabilities to AI clients via MCP server endpoints for font conversion, subsetting, and web export.
capabilities.title: Support CLI and MCP automation

limitations.text: The package requires Python 3.10 or later, limiting use in older environments.
No evidence of support for font conversion between formats (e.g., TTF to WOFF2) beyond subsetting and packaging; conversion is limited to internal processing.
MCP support is optional and requires installing the `mcp>=1.0` dependency separately.

problems_solved.text: Enables variable-font instance instantiation, axis inspection, and compatibility checking without native dependencies.
Produces browser-ready web-font packages with coverage diagnostics, naming policies, and STAT support.
Generates visual review assets such as PNG, SVG, HTML reports, and animation packages for variable-font validation.
Supports automation via CLI and MCP server for font conversion, subsetting, and web export in CI environments.

product_summary.text: Aspose Font FOSS for Python is a pure-Python library for font workflow automation, enabling teams to prepare, review, package, and explain fonts without native runtime dependencies.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports OpenType CFF2 (variable fonts based on CFF2) is not explicitly stated in the fact dossier.

The exact set of supported input formats beyond .ttf is implied but not confirmed by format facts; evidence for .otf, .cff, .pfa, .woff, .woff2, .eot comes from public symbols and examples, not format facts.
The behavior of `FontLoader.load()` versus `FontLoader.open()` is not clarified beyond their existence as public symbols.
Whether the library supports font hinting or bytecode manipulation is not evident from the fact dossier.

workflows.name: Web font packaging
workflows.text: Build web handoff packages with `WebFontBuilder.build()` or `SmartInstancer.build_web_bundle()` to generate font files, manifest, and preview assets.

workflows.name: Variable-font QA reporting
workflows.text: Generate QA evidence packages with `FontQaReporter.build_package()` to produce JSON, HTML, and preview PNG for font review.

workflows.name: Instance review boards
workflows.text: Create visual comparison boards for named instances using `SmartInstancer.build_family_review_board()` to output PNG review sheets.

workflows.name: Axis grid proofing
workflows.text: Generate axis-grid previews with `SmartInstancer.build_axis_grid_sheet()` to visualize variable-font behavior across weight and width.

workflows.name: Delta and compatibility inspection
workflows.text: Inspect outline changes between instances using `SmartInstancer.compare_delta_glyph()` and `check_compatibility()` to detect interpolation issues.

workflows.name: Animation and showcase generation
workflows.text: Produce APNG sweeps and showcase packages using `AnimationPreviewBuilder` for animated variable-font demonstrations.
